description: This PHP class defines a form processor for filtering data within the Goteo project, including form creation, data handling, and saving logic.

classes.name: FilterForm
classes.description: A form processor class for creating, validating, and saving filter forms in the Goteo project.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes and adds various form fields for filtering data, including text, choice, date, location, and other input types.

methods.name: getAssociativeArrayChoices
methods.description: Converts an associative array into a choices array suitable for form options.

methods.name: getAntiquityChoices
methods.description: Returns predefined choices for date range filters.

methods.name: getRolesChoices
methods.description: Provides choices for user roles in the filter.

methods.name: getDonorStatusChoices
methods.description: Provides choices for donor status filters.

methods.name: getTypeOfDonorChoices
methods.description: Provides choices for types of donors.

methods.name: getNoYesChoices
methods.description: Returns Yes/No choices for boolean filters.

methods.name: getSocialCommitmentsAsChoices
methods.description: Retrieves all social commitments and formats them as choices.

methods.name: getSocialCommitmentsData
methods.description: Extracts social commitment IDs from the model for form data.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data, rebuilds the model, and saves the filter configuration, handling errors accordingly.
